utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Eli, any word on when that repair drive is supposed to head out?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Not yet, Ira. I wish they'd give us a solid timeline—I like to plan my day around these things.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, me too. I've got errands to run, but I don't want to miss them if they show up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I heard something about that. What's the deal?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's a community event to fix broken items. Bring your stuff to the community center Saturday at 10.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, I might drop by if I'm free. What kind of stuff can we bring?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure that repair drive is going to work? I've seen those things fail before.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I know, I've been thinking the same thing. Did we check if it's compatible with our specific system?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Compatibility? That's a good point. Have you looked at the manual yet?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I was supposed to bring that old blender of mine, wasn't I? Did I miss it?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, don't worry, Oren—I think the drive is still going on this afternoon. You haven't missed it yet!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that's a relief! I was worried I'd forgotten again. What time does it end?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: The repair drive? Can you tell me more about what's needed?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Repair drive? Sorry, I think I missed something—what are you referring to?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, I thought you mentioned needing help with a repair drive earlier. Maybe I misunderstood?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I'm late. Did I miss anything important for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane! We're still getting everything sorted, just waiting on a few more people to show up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good to hear I didn't miss much then. So, what do we still need to get done?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Need a hand with that repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I've got a toolbox full of stuff if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: What are we fixing first? I can grab my own tools if needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Faye, are we talking about the repair drive for the community center?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I heard about it. How can I help coordinate around school schedules?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We could map out pick-up times and locations around the school drop-off and pick-up windows.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Quinn, have you heard about the community repair drive happening this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh yes, I was just about to tell everyone! Let me help you get the word out around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That's great, thanks Quinn! Maybe we can put up flyers at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what's this repair drive all about?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm not sure. I heard someone mention it, but I don't know the details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Why don't we go ask the person who mentioned it?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Nell, I heard there's a repair drive this weekend, are you going?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I'm bringing my broken toaster.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli! I'm so glad you're here to talk about the upcoming repair drive. How can we make it a success together?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Well, I'll do what I can, but I've been going through some things lately.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I'm sorry to hear that, Uli. If you need any support or just someone to talk to, I'm here. But no pressure at all—we can figure out how to work this drive around your situation.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Eli, did you hear about the repair drive this weekend? They're fixing up old appliances for free.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, that sounds nice. What time does it start on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think it starts at 9 AM, but you might want to get there early—they're expecting a big crowd!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I'm late. What's this about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh hey Dane! So the plan is to have a neighborhood repair drive next Saturday—bring broken stuff and we fix it together.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That sounds like a great idea! I've got a few things that could use fixing—can I bring my old toaster?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What's a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's when neighbors get together to help fix things around the house.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds nice. Do people help with things like plumbing or just small repairs?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey, Opal, what's this about the repair drive? Give me the quick version.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The repair drive starts at 9 AM Saturday in the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, 9 AM Saturday. Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, I heard you're organizing that repair drive. How's it going?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm still gathering details. Can you tell me more about what you've heard?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard it's going to be a community event where people bring broken items to be fixed, with volunteers helping out. Sounds like a great way to cut down on waste.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Repair drive? Did I miss something?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We're collecting tools and supplies to fix up the community center this weekend. I thought I mentioned it at the last block party.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the block party! Sorry, I've been scatterbrained. What kind of tools do you need?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the repair drive? How's it going?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Going well! I've got my toolbox ready and I'm happy to lend a hand if anyone needs it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That's great, Gus! Have you had any takers yet?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Leo, what's this about a repair drive? Need any help?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, we're fixing up the old playground equipment. Could use an extra hand this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I'll be there. What time should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Are we sure we have all the tools we need for the drive? I'd hate to get stuck halfway.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you check the toolkit yet? I remember we have a wrench set and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I checked the toolkit, but I'm worried we might be missing a socket wrench for those tight bolts.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo! I was just about to ask if you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday. We're all pitching in to fix up the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, I already started sorting through the spare paint and lumber in my garage. Let me know what else you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, Cleo! That paint and lumber will be perfect. Could you also round up some brushes and rollers? I'll grab the snacks for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Oren, I was thinking about the repair drive this weekend. Do you know what time it starts?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I can't quite recall the time... I think it might be in the morning?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yeah, I think it's at 9 AM. Are you planning to bring something to fix?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell, I'm so glad we're finally getting the repair drive started. Have you had a chance to line up any volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven't really lined anyone up yet—I've mostly been hearing about it through the grapevine.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No worries at all! How about we brainstorm some folks in the neighborhood who might be willing to help out?
